name: @hasna/clip
description: Local and self-hosted screenshot and clipboard sharing with CLI, SDK, MCP, HTTP API, and a macOS menu bar app

scripts.build: bun run clean && bun run build:cli && bun run build:mcp && bun run build:server && bun run build:lib && bun run build:types
scripts.build:cli: bun build src/cli/index.ts --outdir dist/cli --target bun --packages external --splitting
scripts.build:mcp: bun build src/mcp/index.ts --outdir dist/mcp --target bun --packages external --splitting
scripts.build:server: bun build src/server/index.ts --outdir dist/server --target bun --packages external --splitting
scripts.build:lib: bun build src/index.ts src/storage.ts src/server/server.ts --outdir dist --target bun --packages external --splitting
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun test && bun run build && bun run check:macos

author: Hasna Inc.
